test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: ‘Abba: God's Greatest Gift to Us’ was penned by sons of which great musician?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amjad Ali Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abba: God's Greatest Gift to Us:-**

 
 
• **It is a heartfelt tribute by two sons, Amaan Ali Khan and Ayaan Ali Bangash, to their father and guru, Ustad Amjad Ali Khan, a legendary sarod maestro. **
 
• The book delves into the life of this extraordinary musician, tracing his journey from a young prodigy to a global icon.
 
• Through personal anecdotes, insightful observations, and a deep understanding of their father's artistry, the brothers paint a vivid portrait of a man who has dedicated his life to music.
 
• **The book is divided into seven sections, each exploring a different facet of Ustad Amjad Ali Khan's life and legacy.**
 
• From his early years in Gwalior, where he grew up surrounded by music, to his international fame and collaborations with renowned artists, the book chronicles his remarkable achievements.
 
• **The brothers also share their own experiences as their father's disciples, offering a glimpse into the rigorous training and deep connection they share with him.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bismillah Khan:-**

 
 
• He was known for his soulful renditions of ragas on the Shehnai, a traditional Indian wind instrument.
 
• He was awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award, in 2001.
 
 
 
• **Ali Akbar Khan:-**
 
 
• He was a virtuoso of the Sarod, a stringed instrument. He was known for his innovative playing style and his ability to create a wide range of sounds.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Bhushan, India's third highest civilian award, in 1972.
 
 
 
• **Amir Khan:-**
 
 
• He was a master of the Sarangi, a bowed stringed instrument.
 
• He was known for his expressive singing and his ability to convey deep emotions through his music.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Shri, India's fourth highest civilian award, in 1971.
